name: @240xu/dsh-seqguard
description: DSH web plugin: session seq integrity guard. Detects the duplicate-seq corruption class (bionic no-write-lease race, deepseek-harness discussion #8984) and auto-repairs the single-shift shape with backup, temp+rename publish, and post-write validation. Read-mostly: never writes unless a repairable file passes idle/fd/stability gates.
author: 240xu
